title: Rule-Dependent Prerequisite Gating of Continuation in GPT-5.4
author: Sharthok Rayan Pal

interaction_intervals.method: signed sums of four simultaneous Bonferroni-Wilson cell intervals

primary_firth.penalty: 0.5*log(det(X'WX)) using the full four-parameter model at every constrained and unconstrained fit
primary_firth.profile: Maximize the same penalized likelihood over three free cell logits at fixed interaction coefficient; BFGS analytic gradient, maxiter=500, gtol=1e-10, followed by up to 12 analytic-Hessian Newton refinements with backtracking; required final score infinity norm<=1e-6.
primary_firth.test: two-sided penalized likelihood-ratio interaction test at beta3=0 using chi-square(1)
primary_firth.standard_error: ordinary binomial Fisher information at the Firth estimate; not used for primary decision

denominators: Retain every terminal recorded slot including operational ERROR. Report expected 200, recorded total, and model-completed total separately. Missing slots are not imputed. Any incomplete model-outcome set is INCONCLUSIVE.

decision.SUPPORTED: 800 definitive model outcomes, no ERROR slots, protocol and independent-verifier PASS with zero discrepancies, positive I_V0, and positive Firth interaction with lower profile95 limit>0
decision.NOT SUPPORTED: All model outcomes complete with intact protocol but the primary criterion is not met
decision.INCONCLUSIVE: Incomplete outcomes, missing evidence, integrity failure, model/prompt/schedule substitution, or numerical failure of the preregistered interaction analysis

independence: Analysis reads only independent_verifier classifications after the run; no imports from the runner or runner classifier.
freeze: Analysis code, plan, preregistration, and synthetic tests publicly committed and tagged v1.0.0-preregistered before any primary request.
interpretation_boundary: Observable rule-dependent prerequisite gating under the exact construction. Meaning versus lexical matching and internal mechanism are not identified.
